status.label: Injured Reserve
status.shortComment: The Giants officially placed Dart (knee) on injured reserve Thursday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.
status.longComment: This transaction was inevitable after it was revealed Dart will miss the rest of the regular season due to damage to the MCL, PCL and meniscus that he suffered in his left knee during the Giants' Week 2 loss to the Rams. Fortunately for Dart, his ACL is intact, and head coach John Harbaugh also told Connor Hughes of SNY.tv on Wednesday that the second-year quarterback may be able to return in the postseason, if the team qualifies. In the meantime, Jameis Winston will cover QB duties for the Giants.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Thomas (groin) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice,  Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.
status.longComment: Thomas exited Monday's game in the fourth quarter with a groin injury. The adductor issue he suffered is not considered a serious injury, and the left tackle could play in Sunday's game against the Titans, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Thomas will probably spend the week as a limited practice participant before likely suiting up for Sunday's game to play through the injury.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Burns (ankle) was estimated as a non-participant for the Giants' walkthrough practice Wednesday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.
status.longComment: Per Adam Schefter of ESPN, Burns is not expected to need surgery to address the low-ankle sprain he suffered during Monday's loss against the Rams, but it is anticipated that he will miss some time. Until he's able to get back onto the field, Kayvon Thibodeaux figures to see an uptick in reps on the edge.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Banks (calf) was estimated as a limited participant for the Giants' walkthrough practice Wednesday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.
status.longComment: Banks was unable to practice at the end of last week before sitting out Monday's loss against the Rams, so his designation is relatively encouraging. He'll have opportunities to practice in earnest Thursday and Friday ahead of Sunday's game versus the Titans.

status.label: Questionable
status.shortComment: Nubin (calf) was estimated as a limited participant for the Giants' walkthrough practice Wednesday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.
status.longComment: Nubin played all 62 of the Giants' defensive snaps in their loss against the Rams on Monday, so it's possible his calf injury is only a minor one. If he can practice fully Thursday or Friday, he could still avoid taking an injury designation into the weekend.
